calculateRowAmount.fn: function(ctx, row) { var quantity = Number(row.quantity) || 0; var taxFreePrice = Number(row.taxFreePrice) || 0; var taxRate = Number(row.taxRate) || 0; row.taxFreeSum = Number((quantity * taxFreePrice).toFixed(2)); row.taxAmount = Number((quantity * taxFreePrice * taxRate * 0.01).toFixed(2)); row.taxIncludedSum = Number((row.taxFreeSum + row.taxAmount).toFixed(2)); row.bookSum = row.taxFreeSum; row.difference = Number((row.taxFreeSum - row.bookSum).toFixed(2)); var editTable = ctx.getNode('TableEdit::edit-table'); if(editTable){ editTable.exposed.sumRow(); } }
